name: spring-boot-skills
description: Kimi Code CLI skills for Spring Boot 4 / Java backend and AI engineering: scaffold, persistence, caching, messaging, security, DevOps, testing, observability, Spring AI RAG, MCP servers, legacy migration, and long-form technical writing.
author: Dancan254

interface.shortDescription: Spring Boot 4 scaffold, data, caching, messaging, security, DevOps, testing, observability, Spring AI RAG, MCP, and migration skills for Kimi Code CLI.
interface.longDescription: A skill pack for building and shipping production-ready Spring Boot 4 / Java backends — including the AI engineering layer. Includes spring-scaffold for bootstrapping convention-compliant projects, spring-data-jpa and redis-setup for persistence and caching, kafka-setup and rabbitmq-setup for messaging, spring-security and security-hardening for security, devops-scaffold for Docker and CI, spring-testing for Testcontainers and Boot 4 test APIs, otel-setup for OpenTelemetry end to end, spring-ai-rag and mcp-server for Spring AI work, legacy-migration for Boot 2.x/3.x upgrades, and article for drafting long-form technical pieces in your voice.
